name: Fish/Seafood Entrée
description: Choice of walleye, cod, sea bass, halibut, salmon, shrimp — grilled, seared, blackened, pan-seared, or roasted. Pumpernickel-Crusted Walleye, En Papillote Salmon, Shrimp Scampi, Seafood Bouillabaisse, Lobster in Cream Sauce. Entrée served with a starch and seasonal vegetables.
